As a Partner Solutions Architect (MSP), you won't just be supporting sales deals; you will influence and execute our technical MSP strategy from the ground up. Sitting at the absolute bleeding edge of technology, you will serve as the lead technical strategist empowering top-tier Managed Service Providers to rethink cloud security, package high-margin Wiz-powered offerings, and protect their clients' multi-cloud estates with the power of the Wiz Security Graph and our agentless architecture.
